reason: In public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useIsRuleEditable.ts:23-25, useIsRuleEditable calls featureDiscoveryApi.endpoints.discoverDsFeatures.useQuery({ rulesSourceName }) unconditionally without skipping when rule is undefined, only checking if (!rule) later at line 43.
